completion_decisions: Register WFASP and the complete macro-meso-micro framework as the target paper-paired contribution; the meso shape heuristic is the primary method novelty.
Register the eight Table-1 seeds and both optimized-shape and best-rectangle design roles, not unrelated comparison baselines.
Consume the cited T31 paper and official DOI 10.11583/DTU.13134731 offshore dataset because the target UK arrays and source are unavailable.
Map A-G to public fields D-J and give H an independently offset role on I; every proxy identity is emitted and no UK-native identity is claimed.
Use the published 100 NREL-15MW turbines, Jensen wake lineage, PtA, density, area, capacity, spacing, lifetime, discount, price and cable constraints.
Use a deterministic 800 m legal candidate grid, 15 km meso radius from the paper-tested range, six orientations, five aspect ratios and a 3 by 3 local macro screen.
Use the best feasible rectangle as a completion certificate so each greedy meso commit provably retains enough legal positions to reach 100 turbines.
Calibrate only one layout-independent missing cost offset per seed to the paper rectangle NPV; keep every energy, foundation, cable and shape change live.
Complete the cited VNS with T31 random-conic, 3D/5D/8D neighborhoods, 128 one-opt candidates, counter-keyed events and incumbent retention.
Parallelize fixed wakes, pair construction, macro designs, meso candidates and all micro turbine-slot neighborhoods with persistent C++ worker teams.
Run one/all-worker fixed-work H6, then eight formal seeds with equal 1800-second shape and rectangle micro optimization on Waffle.

paper.authors: Davide Cazzaro and Alessio Trivella and Francesco Corman and David Pisinger
paper.title: Multi-Scale Optimization of the Design of Offshore Wind Farms

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of the complete three-scale method and eight paper roles using explicit same-lineage offshore proxies; not author code, exact UK arrays, target layouts, random stream or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 100 turbines, 1.2 km spacing, area at most 500 km2, density at least 3 MW/km2, PtA at most 5, legal public candidate mask and a feasible-reserve completion certificate

decision_variables.resolution: macro cell/orientation/ratio, meso ordered candidate placement and shape hull, and micro discrete positions for 100 turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: integer indices into a deterministic 800 m coarsening of official legal offshore candidates; every layout and proxy identity is emitted

initialization.resolution: Table-1 target seed role mapped to a public field seed centre; rectangle screening supplies only a feasibility reserve for meso construction

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: NPV and components, AEP, tender constraints, pair/macro/meso/micro work, phase times, worker receipt and hash; one result per paper seed because no independent repeats are reported

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize discounted 25-year energy revenue less foundation, inter-array, export and layout-independent project costs

paper_native_cases.resolution: seeds A-H with target coordinates, regions, optimized shape anchors, best rectangle anchors and equal micro optimization for both design roles

parameters.resolution: 0.0625-degree-equivalent local cells, six orientations, five aspect ratios, 800 m candidate cells, 15 km meso radius, 3D/5D/8D VNS radii and 128 one-opt candidates

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: literal 1800 seconds separately for constructed-shape and rectangle micro VNS; fixed cycles only for H5/H6; pair, macro, meso and micro candidate work reported instead of mislabelled FES

update_order.resolution: parallel candidate scoring followed by one ordered macro selection, meso placement, VNS move/shake and incumbent commit; counter-keyed events preserve fixed-work identity

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: official NREL-15MW and RVO/fixed-wake Jensen pair physics, official foundation costs, MST inter-array cable, published export price and one rectangle-anchored layout-independent cost offset

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: each paper role emits its D-J or independently offset I public proxy; no ERA5-native identity is claimed

development_h6_20260731.comparison_boundary: same pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB or author-Python comparison
